description: Marks one lead as the owner does on Taseli's Leads page: good, bad (not relevant), closed (became a customer; value = what the deal was worth, in the business's currency) or new again. It changes the business's own lead record, never an ad account; good leads and deals then teach Google and Meta which leads matter, where the owner switched that on. The owner, an admin or a manager only. The lead's id comes from the list of leads.

id.description: The lead's id, from the list of leads.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

quote.description: In Taseli's own chat: the person's own words asking for it in this message, as they wrote them.

status.description: good, bad (not relevant), closed (a customer) or new.

value.description: closed only: what the deal was worth.

name: leads_mark

error.description: quote, role, id, status, value, not_found or unavailable.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

title: Mark a lead
